Udyam & MSME Registration Assistance

Get help understanding current Udyam portal steps and preparing information for an eligible micro, small or medium enterprise registration.

For: Owners of eligible small businesses who need help understanding the Udyam portal and preparing registration information.

Start in 4 steps WhatsApp Call

Ground Floor, Singh Building, Shop No-3, Hanuman Mandir Road, Kharangajhar, Telco Colony, Jamshedpur, Jharkhand 831004 · हिन्दी में पढ़ें · বাংলায় পড়ুন

HOW WE HELP

What we can do for you

  • Udyam portal navigation assistance
  • Business information and checklist preparation
  • Applicant review before submission
  • Acknowledgement and registration-status guidance
CHECKLIST

Documents to prepare

Requirements vary by applicant. Use this as a starting list; we confirm the latest before you visit.

  • 1PAN and Aadhaar details required by the current official process
  • 2Business name, activity and contact details
  • 3Bank or enterprise information requested by the official portal
BEFORE YOU VISIT

A little prep, a lot less running around

01

Confirm whether you need a new registration or a correction to an existing record.

02

Review the official Udyam portal's current eligibility and required details.

03

Keep authentication private and review all enterprise declarations before submitting.

THE PROCESS

What happens next

  1. Confirm whether you need a new registration or an update to an existing record.
  2. Review the official portal's current eligibility and information requirements.
  3. The business owner verifies declarations and completes required authentication.
  4. Save the official acknowledgement and use the portal for status or certificate access.

QUESTIONS CUSTOMERS ASK

Frequently asked questions

Does NISE COMPORT issue an MSME certificate?

No. Udyam registration is handled through the official government portal. We can assist with navigation and preparation; the portal issues the registration record.

Is Udyam registration free on the official portal?

Check the current official Udyam portal for its latest terms. Any separate assistance charge will be explained before you proceed.

Is Udyam registration handled by NISE COMPORT?

No. Registration is through the official government portal. NISE COMPORT can help with process navigation; the portal handles the record.

What assistance charge applies?

We explain any separate assistance fee before you decide. Check the official portal for its current terms and do not confuse an assistance charge with a government fee.
